title: Spiced Turkish Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish made with Turkish pilaf and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add Turkish pilaf and stir to combine with garlic.
Add 2 cups water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add chewy (if using) and stir to combine.
Season with garlicky and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs (if desired).
